Name: WhoisFreaks
Author: WhoisFreaks - support@whoisfreaks.com
Description: The WhoisFreaks solution for Microsoft Sentinel ingests WhoisFreaks threat intelligence and newly registered domain feeds through an Azure Function and the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API. The solution includes a unified KQL parser, analytics rules for TI and NRD matches, hunting queries, and an overview workbook.
WorkbookDescription: WhoisFreaks overview: ingestion volume, feed breakdown, top TLDs, NRD age, and threat-domain activity.
WorkbookBladeDescription: This Microsoft Sentinel Solution installs workbooks. Workbooks provide a flexible canvas for data monitoring, analysis, and the creation of rich visual reports within the Azure portal.
AnalyticalRuleBladeDescription: This solution installs the following analytic rule templates. After installing the solution, manage analytic rules in the Analytics blade.
HuntingQueryBladeDescription: This solution installs the following hunting queries. After installing the solution, run them from the Hunting blade.
PlaybooksBladeDescription: This solution does not include playbook templates.
